enforced.average-rate 1% crossing: where the model's fitted average failure rate first reaches 1%
enforced.median-task 1% crossing: where the median task's failure rate reaches 1%
enforced.average-rate 50% crossing: where the fitted average failure rate reaches even odds
enforced.median-task 50% crossing: where the median task reaches even odds
enforced.level pair (1%, 50%): two linked crossings of one trend, always written with concrete levels — never variables
enforced.cumulative 1% failure rate: the hardest difficulty such that average failure over ALL easier tasks is still ≤ 1%
enforced.worst-stretch 1% failure rate: the same, but EVERY trailing stretch of easier tasks must stay ≤ 1% — easy wins cannot bank budget for later failures
enforced.first task above 1% failure: the last difficulty before the first single task failing more than 1%
enforced.cumulative X% failure rate: the same machine at any other concrete anchor
enforced.99%-assured: prefix: quoted at the value it holds with 99% posterior probability

soft.success-mass balance point: everything the model solves, added up and read as one position on the difficulty axis — mean pass rate expressed as a difficulty
soft.contested mass: how much of the difficulty axis the model SOMETIMES solves and sometimes fails — the width of its struggle zone

dropped_no_unification: frontier reads (dark range, d2, dM, solved-mass edge, L)

scope.binds: value labels — wherever a bare reserved word functions as the label of a displayed number (axis names, tooltip labels, table headers over numbers, stat-tile captions)
scope.exempt_tool_names: tool/site/page names denote subject matter, not measurements, and are exempt
scope.litmus: if deleting the word would leave a number unlabeled, the reservation applies; if it would merely rename a surface, it does not

sampling.attempt: the counting noun: one generation of one arm on one task, judged as a unit; count = n_attempts, the store's field of record (n is read per cell, never assumed)
sampling.sample: the text an attempt produced (the samples-file identity hashes are over sample strings)
sampling.rollout: retired alias — not introduced in new prose; served titles change at their next content edit

capC.method_version: capability-C v2026-09-01c (uniform difficulty marginal, full-axis estimator, monotone completion; ci80 bootstrap B=400)
capC.name: Capability (uniform)
capC.marginal_plain: population weighted evenly along the failure level (uniform in u on [0, 1]; Voronoi cell mass in u; uncovered easy end credited solved)
capC.distribution: uniform: even weight along the failure level on 0 to 1, Beta(1,1)
capC.source: analysis/battery/make_u_frame.py (formula: C_m = u_lo + sum_t w_t (1 - f_mt/n_t), Voronoi-in-u weights; uncovered easy end credited solved, hard end failed)

capC_z.method_version: capability-C v2026-09-14z (difficulty uniform in logit over the axis's task range, Voronoi-in-z weights normalised to one, full-axis estimator, monotone completion; ci80 bootstrap B=400)
capC_z.name: Capability (Haldane)
capC_z.marginal_plain: population weighted evenly along the difficulty scale (uniform in logit over the axis's task range; Voronoi cell mass in z, normalised)
capC_z.distribution: Haldane: even weight per logit step over the tasks' range, the improper Beta(0,0) cut at the easiest and hardest task
capC_z.source: analysis/battery/make_u_frame.py NU_MARGINAL=z (formula: C_m = sum_t w_t (1 - f_mt/n_t), Voronoi-in-logit weights over the axis's task range normalised to one; no end credit: the range is the tasks')

capC_j.method_version: capability-C v2026-09-14j (difficulty weighted by Beta(1/2,1/2) on the failure level — the Jeffreys prior of a pass/fail rate — Voronoi cell masses under it, full-axis estimator, monotone completion; ci80 bootstrap B=400)
capC_j.name: Capability (Jeffreys)
capC_j.marginal_plain: population weighted by the Jeffreys prior of a pass/fail rate (Beta(1/2,1/2) on the failure level; heavier at both ends; proper, no range cut; uncovered easy end credited solved)
capC_j.distribution: Jeffreys: the arcsine law Beta(1/2,1/2) on the failure level, heavier at both ends, no range cut
capC_j.source: analysis/battery/make_u_frame.py NU_MARGINAL=jeffreys (formula: C_m = G(u_lo) + sum_t w_t (1 - f_mt/n_t), w_t the Beta(1/2,1/2) mass of the task's Voronoi cell in u, G its cdf; proper, no range cut; uncovered easy end credited solved)
